text:
I tried generating this type of video with Seedance, but the result didn't turn out as expected.

I used GPT Image 2.0 to combine several landmarks into a single image and then used it as the starting point for video generation.

Looking back, I think the issue might be related to the camera language. The video starts from the perspective of a static image rather than from a clearly defined camera movement.

Workflow: https://t.co/nLWrvQXGno
content: Define explicit camera movement in your Seedance prompt (e.g., dolly-in/pan/tilt/orbit) when animating from a single starting image to avoid a static-image perspective.

translations.es: Define un movimiento de cámara explícito en tu prompt de Seedance (por ejemplo, dolly-in/pan/tilt/orbit) al animar desde una sola imagen inicial para evitar una perspectiva de imagen estática.
translations.fr: Définissez un mouvement de caméra explicite dans votre prompt Seedance (par exemple, dolly-in/pan/tilt/orbit) lors de l'animation à partir d'une seule image de départ pour éviter une perspective d'image statique.
translations.ja: Seedanceのプロンプトで、単一の開始画像からアニメーションを作成する際に、静止画像の視点を避けるために、dolly-in/pan/tilt/orbitなどの明確なカメラの動きを定義してください。
translations.ko: Seedance 프롬프트에서 명확한 카메라 움직임(예: dolly-in/pan/tilt/orbit)을 정의하여 단일 시작 이미지에서 애니메이션을 만들 때 정적인 이미지 관점을 피하세요.
translations.pt-BR: Defina movimentos de câmera explícitos no seu prompt Seedance (por exemplo, dolly-in/pan/tilt/orbit) ao animar a partir de uma única imagem inicial para evitar uma perspectiva de imagem estática.
translations.zh-CN: 在您的Seedance prompt中定义明确的摄像机运动（例如，dolly-in/pan/tilt/orbit），以避免从单一起始图像动画时出现静态图像视角。
